# Apple Music MCP Curator v1.4.0

This stable release sharpens the project around one job: turning a nuanced musical brief into a
playlist whose selections, exact recordings, narrative arc, and transitions hold together.

## Highlights

- **A real difficult curation demo.** The README now follows *A Machine Dreams It Is Human* from a
  22-track candidate pool to a 12-track, three-act playlist. It records exact-version rejections,
  12/12 audio-feature coverage, narrative locks, and a 12/12 create dry run.
- **Language understanding stays in charge.** The host model owns imagery, culture, lyrical angle,
  narrative roles, and final selection. Deterministic audio rules may improve local transitions,
  but cannot replace or cross the model's semantic boundaries.
- **Stronger catalog grounding.** Unrequested `(Mixed)` releases and unknown trailing qualifiers
  such as alternate-version subtitles are now surfaced in `version_markers` instead of silently
  passing as the requested studio recording.
- **PyPI-first installation.** All nine localized READMEs and client guides now use the published
  zero-runtime-dependency `apple-music-playlists` package by default.
- **Official MCP Registry readiness.** A validated `server.json` and manual, approval-gated GitHub
  OIDC workflow are included. Registry metadata can only be published after the matching PyPI
  package exists.
- Community standards, discovery metadata, social-preview assets, tool descriptions, and CI
  version checks were tightened for maintainers and directory reviewers.

## Install or upgrade

```bash
pip install --upgrade apple-music-playlists
am-playlist status
```

Existing credentials and feature caches stay in the same per-user locations. No re-login or data
migration is required. See the
[changelog](https://github.com/Z-Han-Z/apple-music-playlists/blob/v1.4.0/CHANGELOG.md) for the full
list of changes.
